15.t: Working with data: surface area and volume
q: State the volume of a 2 cm cube.
3 cm cube: 54 : 27 = 2 : 1. 4 cm cube: surface area 6 × 16 = 96 cm².
Describe what happens to SA : V as a cube gets bigger.
The ratio gets smaller: volume grows faster than surface area.
Explain why large animals need lungs and a circulation but tiny organisms do not.
Large animals have a small SA : V: their surface is too small to take in enough oxygen by diffusion for all their cells. Lungs add surface area; blood carries gases further.
